discussions.prompt:
Casual merge game inventory overview sheet, 2x4 grid, eight white rounded cards on dark charcoal background. Soft-plastic cute cartoon chickens, warm softbox lighting, short contact shadow, glossy but not oily. One single chicken centered per cell, no face UI, no level numbers, no hen house, no cage, no flock of multiple birds.

Row1 L1 hatchling yellow fluff in cracked eggshell tiny almost no wings.
L2 standing yellow baby chick short wings orange feet.
L3 juvenile chick feathers starting two-tone yellow to tan short wings.
L4 pullet leaner body short tail tiny comb bud.
Row2 L5 adult hen round body clear red comb cream-brown layered feathers SINGLE bird.
L6 ornate plumage hen SAME single bird: thicker feather layers, readable wing fan and tail fan expanded (NOT a group).
L7 gold-crest hen SINGLE: gold-edged primary feathers, tall golden comb crest readable at thumbnail.
L8 regal prestige hen SINGLE largest: gold feather cape/cloak readable, gem on crown crest. Still one bird only.

Family lock warm yellow fluff to amber-brown plumage to red comb with late gold prestige accents. Scale gently increases L1 smallest to L8 largest. Fail-at-glance: multiple birds in one cell, chicken coop/building, empty prettier with no gold fan/cape/gem readable deltas, cyber neon, oily plastic, text labels.
